title: Stripper Loses It on Cops After Attacking Husband In Front Of Her Kids
description:
On November 3rd, 2024. A 911 call was placed regarding a stripper who publicly assaulted her husband at a gas station. When officers confronted her she immediately started denying it and being confrontational. This is the footage of the events.
